companyDescription.text:
About Grab and Our Workplace

Grab is Southeast Asia's leading superapp. From getting your favourite meals delivered to helping you manage your finances and getting around town hassle-free, we've got your back with everything. In Grab, purpose gives us joy and habits build excellence, while harnessing the power of Technology and AI to deliver the mission of driving Southeast Asia forward by economically empowering everyone, with heart, hunger, honour, and humility.

jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text:
Get to Know the Team

Applied AI Team is a group of passionate engineers committed to architecting, crafting, and maintaining internal tooling systems, frameworks and platforms that elevate the very core of our business operations. With unyielding, we create functional applications that not only enhance productivity but also redefine efficiency for Grab employees. Join us in this journey as we pioneer the future of technology, pushing the boundaries of what's possible to shape Grab's success.

Get to Know the Role

As a Software Engineer on our team, you will be the technical backbone of LLM-Kit, Grab's framework for building, deploying, and monitoring LLM and agentic applications, and the standard starting point through which teams across the organization ship AI products. You will build the libraries, scaffolding, and CLI that give engineers a paved road from empty repo to a production LLM service: pre-configured FastAPI project structure, a default ReAct agent with MCP integration, GrabGPT connectivity, Vault-backed secret management, auth helpers, guardrails, built-in observability, and evaluations wired in out of the box.

You will report to the Engineering Manager and work onsite at the Grab Office.

This role is onsite based in our Petaling Jaya, Malaysia office.

The Critical Tasks You Will Perform

  • Develop Framework Features End-to-End

Independently build complex library and tooling features, agent and MCP integrations, scaffolding templates, CLI subcommands, config and secret management, auth helpers, guardrails, and evaluation hooks, from conception through release and adoption.

  • Design Clean and Composable Abstractions

Design the abstractions teams build on: clean, composable interfaces over LangChain, LangGraph, FastAPI, and MCP adapters.

  • Build Well-Architected Python Libraries and CLIs

Build well-architected Python libraries and CLIs (and Go where it fits Grab's tooling), with rigorous packaging and dependency hygiene on uv, strict semantic versioning, backwards compatibility guarantees, and consistent API conventions across the SDKs.

  • Implement Quality and Governance Layers

Build and operate the platform's quality and governance layers: OpenTelemetry distributed tracing and Datadog metrics baked into generated services, structured logging, Vault secret injection, OIDC/workload-identity authentication, prompt-level guardrails against common adversarial attacks.

  • Ensure Framework Reliability and Support

Ensure the framework is for the teams that depend on it. Participate in on-call and support rotations, triage breakages in scaffolding, dependency, and deployment paths, conduct root cause analysis, and be part of post-mortems.

qualifications.title: Qualifications
qualifications.text:
What Essential Skills You Will Need

  • 2+ years of professional software development experience with a history of delivering successful solutions. Fresh Graduates are welcome.
  • Proficiency in server-side programming, specifically Python and Golang.
  • Hands-on experience with LLMs (Large Language Models), LangChain, and LangGraph for conversational AI development.
  • Practical experience with cloud providers (AWS), containerization (Kubernetes), and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Grasp of data structures, algorithms, distributed systems, and multi-threading.
  • An advocate for automated testing (unit, integration) and writing concise technical documentation.
  • Experience with a relational database such as MySQL, PostgreSQL, or Oracle

jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text:
Get to Know the Team

The Payments team sits at the center of the Grab experience. We build the mobile payment journeys that users rely on every day from checkout and stored payment methods to transaction reliability and security. Our work directly impacts conversion, user confidence, and platform growth across multiple products and markets.

 

Get to know the Role:

We are looking for a strong Android engineer to help shape the future of payments on Grab. This is a role for someone who cares deeply about product quality, technical craft, and building systems that perform reliably at scale.

You will work on highly visible, business-critical flows used by millions of users across Southeast Asia. You'll partner closely with product, design, backend, risk, and platform teams to build intuitive payment experiences that are fast, secure.

You will be reporting to Software Engineering Manager II

The Day-to-Day Activities:

  • Design, build, and maintain Android features powering Grab's payment experience
  • Deliver high-quality, scalable, and resilient mobile solutions for critical user journeys
  • Improve app performance, reliability, observability, and engineering quality in payment flows
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to translate product goals into robust technical solutions
  • Contribute to architecture, technical design, code reviews, and engineering standards
  • Troubleshoot production issues and help drive operational excellence
  • Use data and experimentation to improve customer experience and business outcomes
  • Improve code quality, maintainability, and developer productivity within the team

qualifications.title: Qualifications
qualifications.text:
What Essential Skills You Will Need

  • Strong software engineering fundamentals with solid 5+ years experience building Android applications in production
  • Proficiency in Kotlin and a strong understanding of modern Android development
  • Experience building maintainable mobile architectures and shipping user-facing features at scale
  • Good understanding of performance, reliability, testing, debugging, and release best practices on Android
  • Experience integrating with backend services and handling complex client-server interactions
  • Break down ambiguous problems and deliver pragmatic, high-quality solutions
  • Strong collaboration in a cross-functional environment
  • A product mindset and a high standard for user experience
  • Experience working on payments, fintech, checkout, authentication, or other high-trust product areas
  • Familiarity with Android architecture components, Coroutines, Jetpack, and modern development tooling
  • Experience with experimentation, instrumentation, and data-informed product development
  • Knowledge of secure coding and mobile application security practices
  • Experience working in large-scale consumer technology environments

jobDescription.text:

jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text:
Senior Database Reliability Engineers (DBRE) keep database systems that support all user-facing services and many other Grab production systems running smoothly 24/7/365. DBREs are a blend of database engineering and software developers. They apply sound engineering principles, operational discipline, and mature software development and automation (with Agentive AI capabilities). They specialize in databases, such as MySQL, PostgreSQL, and Vector databases. In that capacity, DBREs are peers to SREs and bring database expertise to the SRE and Infrastructure teams and our engineering teams.

 

The Day-to-Day Activities

  • You will implement best practices across supported datastores ( MySQL, PostgreSQL, and Vector database's).
  • Improve the end-to-end platformization of the database lifecycle to support feature-ready agentic workflows.
  • Transform database platform self-service capabilities into reusable APIs for cross-platform integration.
  • Enhance database reliability and performance across Grab while partnering with application teams to ship solutions.
  • Improve database observability through metric tracking, anomaly detection, and preventive automated actions.
  • Collaborate across platform and application engineering teams to safely deploy production changes and reduce database-related incidents.
  • Provide database expertise to engineering teams through schema migration reviews, query optimization, and performance tuning solutions.
  • Automate database infrastructure and empower engineering teams by delivering self-service tools.
  • Improve database client library, connection pooling, stability, scalability, capacity planning, and performance tuning for Grab's infrastructure.
  • Develop database infrastructure that can scale to support hundreds of thousands of concurrent users.
  • Build the best High Availability (HA) and Business Continuity / Disaster Recovery (BC/DR) solutions.
  • Participate in an on-call rotation to support database production issues across services.

qualifications.title: Qualifications
qualifications.text:
The Must-Haves

  • At least 6 years of experience running MySQL/PostgreSQL databases in large Environments
  • Knowledge in infrastructure automation (Python Programming)
  • Awareness of cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP)
  • Experience with SQL
  • Experience with Linux
  • Experience with stable and secure systems management practices.
  • Knowledge of data modelling and data structure design skills.
  • Experience with AI and Agenting AI capabilities to enhance the automation and platform features.
